name: app.anakior/atlas-mind
description: Self-hosted git-native knowledge base with an MCP endpoint your AI reads, writes and rewinds

packageArguments.description: Folder of your mind, on this machine. A missing or empty one becomes a new mind; an existing one is used as is.

ATLAS_HOST.description: Host of your running Atlas Mind instance, WITHOUT the leading https:// (e.g. your-atlas.example.com). The client signs you in over OAuth and you choose what it may do.

ATLAS_MCP_URL.description: For a client without OAuth: host + path (including the token) of your instance's MCP endpoint, WITHOUT the leading https:// - minted in Settings -> AI assistants in the web UI (or `atlas token create` locally). Example: your-atlas.example.com/mcp/<token>
